items.title: 필수 요구사항
items.rule: Replace with one concrete required deliverable from the pinned assignment spec.
items.pass_rule: Replace with one concrete required deliverable from the pinned assignment spec.

items.source_requirement: Replace with the exact assignment section and explicit required deliverable.

items.title: 주요 결과와 구현의 일치
items.rule: Reported core results and computations agree with submitted implementation and records.
items.pass_rule: Reported core results and computations agree with submitted implementation and records.
items.fail_rule: A contradiction materially changes the result or reproducibility.

items.title: 과제 의도와 해석
